description: This circular walk in Wiltshire explores the lovely Vale of Pewsey and visits the ancient burial long barrow at Giant's Grave. There's also a pleasant waterside section along the Kennet and Avon Canal Walk to enjoy. The walk also climbs to Oare Hill in the Marlborough Downs where you can enjoy some wonderful views over the surrounding countryside. The walk starts and finishes at the Pewsey Wharf car park next to the canal and runs for just under 5 miles. To continue your walking in the area you could try the Pewsey Canal Circular Walk or enjoy a climb to Martinsell Hill for some more fine views over the area.
